list.text: Did you see that?! It's Mew!\nLet's catch it as the boss ordered!
If your Pokemon is poisoned use the Antidote!
Welcome to Viridian Forest.\nEnjoy my Bug-type Pokemon!
Pretty impressive!
I'm sure you can go anywhere with that skill!
Shh! Be quiet!\nThe bug Pokemon will run away!
From Bug-type Pokemon come the sounds of munching on grass, walking on crunchy leaves, swimming in puddles...
For bug Pokemon fans, knowing how to distinguish these sounds is key!
Wow, that's a HUGE Pokemon!
...\n...What kind of Trainer?!
Has anyone ever told you that from behind you look like a Venonat?
I'm sure that there's nothing more efficient and beautiful in this world than a Bug-type Pokemon.
If this is it, then I don't mind losing!
There are many people out there who prefer solid bug Pokemon over squishy bug Pokemon.
Doesn't matter what kind of Pokemon--\nas long as you like them, they all look cute.
Viridian Forest exit.\nPewter ahead.
Hey! Don't even try to disturb our work!
This Pokemon will be ours!\nCatch it was the only job our boss gave us!
If our boss gives an order, we'll accomplish it!
And it's not a kid that will stop us!
Oh no! Where did he go?!
We need to let the boss know about that!\nHe'll be super angry!
